data.title: A Quarter of Large Oil Tankers Trapped by Iran War Have Escaped
data.description: Roughly one-quarter of the non-Iranian large oil tankers trapped inside the Persian Gulf at the outbreak of the Iran war have managed to slip out in a slow, stealthy trickle.
